correctness.rationale: Exact proof enumerates all 389 realizable sign cones using two complete representations and constructs primitive rays from the connected-cut criterion. The included checker verifies 26 fan rays, cone profile 1/26/116/168/78 by dimension, smooth determinants 1 for every simplicial cone, precisely 8 minimal singular three-cones and 4 minimal singular four-cones, disjointness, local primitive relations of 2+2 and 3+2 types with integral saturation, and an independent 78-orientation Hasse-cover count of 58/16/4. Standard toric orbit and semigroup arguments identify eight P1 curves, four isolated 2x3 Segre points and multiplicities 2/3. The finite certificate is exhaustive for exactly five vertices, not an infinite statement.

The earlier single-edge deletion is not a parameter specialization that entails the two-edge deletion result. The wheel \(W_5\) fixed-point count determines only 58 smooth and 20 singular fixed points; it does not determine eight singular curves and four isolated Segre germs.

value.rationale: The specified five-vertex matching deletion is the first connected complete-graph example with two disjoint missing edges and an additional common neighbor. It is the five-vertex wheel \(W_5\) and has non-pure singular support made of eight pairwise disjoint conifold lines and four isolated higher-dimensional Segre singularities, with an exact orbit census and primitive local equations. This is a natural, structurally motivated finite classification and not a global nonsimplicity restatement, arbitrary slice or table-only recomputation.
